Subject: Contoso referral submitted (PC-2026-1147) — need seller mapping

Hi Laura / team,

Sharing a Partner Center referral for Contoso (referral ID PC-2026-1147). Sales Ops at Contoso has indicated they\'re open to a co-sell engagement and have provided a seller list. I\'ve attached the referral export (contoso_partnercenter_referral_export.csv) and included the Partner Center link below.

Ask: can your field org confirm primary seller owners for the accounts and propose a short mutual action plan so we can route the referral and request co-sell approval? Our timeline is tight — Contoso wants an intro call the week of Dec 6.

A few notes:
- Referral includes ~18 accounts across NA/EMEA (volume concentrated in NA).
- Partner Center will required mapped seller owners for co-sell submission.
- If you want, we can split by territory so you own outreach and Microsoft sellers join the intro.

Partner Center referral: https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/referrals/PC-2026-1147
Attachment: contoso_partnercenter_referral_export.csv (CSV; account list + basic contact)

Thanks — Molly
Molly Chen

Thanks Molly — got the referral and the export. I pulled together an initial owner map (attached as account_mapping_v2.csv) with guesses based on recent activity. I\'m proposing we do the following:

1) Field mapping: Karthik — can you validate EMEA owners and POC emails?
2) Co-sell economics: Vanessa / Rishi — confirm who owns the commercial lead so we can set expectations on incentives and any crediting rules.
3) MAP: I\'ve sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) to standardize the intro and next steps — want your feedback and Microsoft\'s.

I\'ve also flagged three accounts that look like highest intent (Contoso-Prod, Contoso-Retail, Contoso-CloudOps) — would prefer to route those first. I\'ll leave notes inline in the CSV.

Attachments: account_mapping_v2.csv (CSV; draft owner column populated), MAPS_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.docx (draft MAP)

Best,
Laura

Thanks team — a couple of asks from finance/ops before we lock the MAP:
1) Can someone add an ARR/TCV estimate for the top three accounts in the CSV (Contoso-Prod, Contoso-Retail, Contoso-CloudOps)? I need that to model commission and potential discounting.
2) I started a HubSpot record for the referral: HSP-77821 — please push additional contact emails there so CS can own onboarding tasks.

I\'m happy to run quick pricing scenarios once we have the ARR estimate. If any of the accounts are >$250k ARR we should consider a short approval window for sales credits.

Thanks everyone — good progress. Quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Action items (owners and timelines):
- Karthik: finalize owner column in account_mapping_v2.csv and add ARR estimates for top three accounts (Due: 2026-12-01 EOD).
- Vanessa: confirm Redwood seller name for intro (I recommend Jonas Weber for Retail) and confirm Dec 1 15:30 UTC as our tentative slot.
- Rishi: run pricing scenarios if any account > $250k ARR and confirm commission/crediting constraints (Due: 2026-12-02).
- Molly / Microsoft: confirm MS seller(s) to join the intro and validate Partner Center submission requirements (Partner Center referral ID: PC-2026-1147).
- Contoso Sales Ops: provide the two AE contacts we should invite.

I uploaded the updated MAP and the latest account_mapping_v2.csv to our shared docs: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/Maps/MAPS_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.docx (please comment directly). HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/77821 (HSP-77821) — add missing contact info there.

If everyone can action the owner/ARR updates by close on Dec 1 we can lock the intro invite for Dec 1 15:30 UTC and submit the co-sell routing that afternoon.

Thanks — Laura
